Q955.reason: The son’s scream is an excited utterance under FRE 803(2), which applies whether or not the declarant is available.

Q909.reason: Normal saline is the recommended isotonic mouth cleanser; peroxide and lemon-glycerine irritate, dry, or damage mucosa and enamel.

Q884.reason: In paralytic diplopia the outer image is the false image; VI palsy causes a convergent squint and IV palsy is worse on looking down.
